In this special episode of The Ranveer Show, we celebrate Krishna Janmashtami by welcoming Vinay Varanasi, a Bengaluru-based storyteller and artist deeply rooted in Sanatan Dharma, spirituality, and Indian culture. Today, we delve into the fascinating life of Sri Krishna, revered as the sustainer of the universe.

Join us as we explore the various aspects of Sri Krishna's life, from his miraculous birth to his roles as a divine hero and a guide in the Bhagavad Gita. We discuss the deep symbolism and the enthralling stories associated with his life, shedding light on his teachings and the profound impact they have on spiritual practices.

Aaj ka din itna simple tha ki shayad batane layak kuch bhi nahi tha... ya phir tha? 😏 Sometimes the most ordinary moments hide the biggest stories. 🚶‍♂️💭

Koi race nahi, koi adventure nahi, koi special plan nahi... bas ek aur normal day. But appearances can be misleading! 👀🔥 Agar aapko lagta hai ki aap pehle hi samajh gaye ho ki video mein kya hoga, then you might be completely wrong. 😅

snippet.description:
Is there really a “magic number” of questions you should attempt in UPSC Prelims?

AIR 100 Sattwik Satyakam Devta explains why chasing a fixed attempt number can actually hurt your score. Instead of blindly targeting 85 or 90 questions, the focus should be on knowledge, elimination and accuracy.

He also explains when you should take a calculated risk, when you should skip a question, and why avoiding unnecessary negative marking can be more important than increasing your attempts.

A simple but important Prelims strategy every aspirant should understand.
